catatan: Food photography Michelin-style untuk website scrollytelling. Sumber prompt: STEP-1 01-makanan-food-image.md dan STEP-2 01-makanan-food-video.md. Subject utama: Wagyu steak.

gaya.blok: Cinematic high-end food photography, Michelin-star editorial plating aesthetic, shot like a food magazine cover. Rich warm color grading with deep greens, golden browns and warm reds. Hyper-realistic food textures: glistening sauces, crisp seared edges, soft steam wisps. Ultra-sharp focus on the hero dish. 8K resolution, premium aesthetic. No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture.
gaya.cahaya_default: soft warm directional light from the upper-left at 45 degrees, golden-hour tone, gentle shadow falloff into pure black

subject: a Wagyu steak seared medium-rare, sliced to reveal a rosy pink center, with a dark caramelized crust and a melting disc of herb butter on top

panggung_hitam.deskripsi: handcrafted matte charcoal-grey ceramic plate on a black matte ceramic surface that fades seamlessly into a pure black background at every edge, no horizon line

penutup: No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture.

video.blok: Same plate, same black background and same warm side light as the first frame; the background stays pure black. Camera locked-off overhead, static. The scene ends on a hold. No text, no dialogue, no voice.
